# dsh-open-obsidian

**这是一个给 DeepSeek Harness（简称 DSH）用的插件，不是 Obsidian 插件。**
装进 Obsidian 里没有任何作用，Obsidian 也不会加载它。
English speakers: jump to the English version.
## 它做什么
两件事，都是为了同一个目的：**让 AI 写进库里的东西真的落盘、真的同步出去。**

**一、库会被自动打开。** 当一个 DSH 会话的工作目录位于某个 Obsidian 库文件夹内时，你在那个会话里
**发出第一条消息**的那一刻，插件会帮你在 Obsidian 里打开这个库。因为

**同步插件（坚果云同步、
Obsidian Sync、Git 插件）只有在 Obsidian 开着的时候才会跑**。

这是它解决的实际问题：AI 在库里写了东西，可 Obsidian 没开着，同步就不会跑——等到
你哪天自己打开 Obsidian，改动才姗姗来迟。现在库会在对话开始时就打开，同步从那一刻起就在走。
它尽可能不打扰你：

- 库**已经开着** → 什么都不做（不新开窗口，也不抢焦点）；
[该节后续省略]
## 运行要求
| 系统 | **仅支持 Windows。** 它依赖 Windows 的进程/窗口接口、`%APPDATA%\obsidian` 注册表，以及 Obsidian 注册的 URL 协议；在 macOS

/ Linux 上无法工作。 |
| DSH | 需要暴露了本插件所用内部接口的 DSH 版本（见下面「已知限制」）。写锁还要求宿主提供 `tools/pre-execute` 钩子。 |
| Ob
sidian | 桌面版 1.x。开发与实测用的是 **1.14.4**。 |
## 已知限制

**1.「打开一个没开的库、同时完全不打扰你」做不到。**
Obsidian 自己没有实现这个能力：它新建窗口用的是会抢焦点的 `show()`，而不是不抢焦点的
`showInactive()`，并

且全程序没有任何跟焦点相关的开关（这是读它自己的 `app.asar` 确认的，
`showInactive` 出现 0 次）。

插件的做法是"新窗口压到后面 + 把焦点抢回来"。所以当被打开的库原本没开着时，**大约三次里
有两次会闪一下，约 0.1 秒**。没有第三条路——外部程序拦不住 Obsidian 自己激活窗口，只能

**接受不了可以关掉「静默打开」，就变回"正常打开、会跳到前台"。**

**2. 插件用了 DSH 的内部接口**（Web 路由注册、会话事件、设置页插槽、`__ModuleLoader__`）。

## What it does

Two things, both for the same reason: **so that what the agent writes into a vault actually
lands on
disk and actually gets synced.**

**1. The vault gets opened.** When a DSH conversation's working directory sits inside an
Obsidian va

ult folder, this plugin opens that vault in Obsidian for you — automatically, once
per conversation,

when you send your first message. Because **a sync plugin (Nutstore sync,
Obsidian Sync, Obsidian G
it) only runs while Obsidian is open.**

**Why that matters:** without it, the agent writes into the vault while Obsidian is closed,
nothing
syncs, and the changes only travel the next time you happen to open Obsidian yourself.
It is deliberately quiet about it:

- If the vault is **already open**, nothing happens — no new window, no focus jump.
- If Obsidian is

**already running**, the new window is pushed to the back and focus is handed
straight back to what

ever you were doing.
- If Obsidian is **not running**, it starts normally (the window appearing is t

ere doing.
- If Obsidian is **not running**, it starts normally (the window appearing is the point).

**2. Only one conversation may write a vault at a time.** Two conversations writing at once get
thei

r edits spliced together by the sync client — the same paragraph twice, two headings glued
into one.

The plugin keeps a **write lock**: another conversation's write is **actually refused**
(the tool n

ever runs, not a byte is written) until the holder is done. See
Write lock.
Everything runs inside the DSH process, outside the model loop: **zero tokens, zero polling.**

> **About the author:** the author has no programming background; the code was written with the
> he
lp of DSH's own AI assistant.
## Requirements
| OS | **Windows only.** It relies on Windows process/window APIs, `%APPDATA%\obsidian`, and Obsidia

n's registered URL protocol. It will not work on macOS or Linux. |
| DSH | A DSH build that exposes
the internal APIs this plugin uses (see *Known limitations*). The write lock additionally needs the

`tools/pre-execute` hook. |
| Obsidian | Desktop 1.x. Developed and tested against 1.14.4. |
### What it looks like
## Known limitations

**1. "Open a closed vault without disturbing me" is not fully achievable.**
Obsidian itself does not

support this: it creates a new vault window with Electron's `show()`
(which activates) rather than

`showInactive()`, and ships no focus-related flag anywhere
(verified by reading its own `app.asar`;
`showInactive` appears zero times).

What this plugin does instead is push the new window to the back and take the foreground back.
In pr

actice you may still see a **~0.1 s flicker about two times out of three** when opening a
vault that

was not already open. There is no third option — an external process cannot prevent
Obsidian's own
window from activating, only correct it afterwards.
**Turn off 静默打开 if you would rather have the window come to the front normally.**

**2. It uses DSH internal APIs** — the web-server route registration, session events, the settings
s

lot, and `__ModuleLoader__`. DSH is evolving quickly; a DSH upgrade can break this plugin until
it i
s updated. Issues are welcome.
